description: Home page: hero section with gradient, inline search bar, category pills, trending projects grid, feature strip, CTA section. Replaces original browse layout as the entry point.

elements.label: Hero banner
elements.purpose: Brand headline, tagline, inline search form, quick stats (project count, categories)

elements.label: Category filter chips
elements.purpose: Horizontal scrollable list of category badges linking to filtered discover view

elements.label: Trending projects
elements.purpose: 3×3 card grid of top-rated approved listings sorted by rating descending

elements.label: Feature highlights
elements.purpose: Three-column feature summary (Discover, Connect, Share) with icons

elements.label: Call-to-action
elements.purpose: Dark gradient box with 'Start Selling Free' and 'Browse Projects' buttons
